name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> name: domain=check_tile_event, descriptor=post_action. Accurately reflects purpose (after landing on a tile, check whether it fires a scripted post-action consequence). No Ghidra address residue.
purpose: After a character lands on tile (world_x, world_y) via a walk-step or action, check whether the tile fires a scripted post-action consequence and latch its consequence index for the next AI phase loop iteration to dispatch.
logic_summary: Reads the 8-byte tile attribute at (world_x, world_y) via fd2_read_tile_attribute_at_pos. Skips animated event-tiles (tile_buf[4] & 0x60 != 0) and tiles with no terrain class (terrain_class == 0). Otherwise indexes data_fd2_tile_event_data_table_ptr by (terrain_class-1)*2, reads consequence_idx at record+0x33 and event_type at record+0x34. When consequence_idx != 0xFF and event_type == expected_event_type, writes consequence_idx into data_fd2_battle_ai_post_action_consequence_idx (the next AI phase loop iteration invokes the consequence handler at that index).
signature: void __cdecl fd2_check_tile_event_post_action(uint32 world_x, uint32 world_y, uint32 expected_event_type)

params.name: world_x
params.semantics: Tile world X coordinate the character just landed on (passed straight to fd2_read_tile_attribute_at_pos).

params.name: world_y
params.semantics: Tile world Y coordinate the character just landed on.

params.name: expected_event_type
params.semantics: Trigger-source discriminator compared against the tile record's event_type byte (+0x34). Callers pass 0 = walked into tile (every walk_step_* via shared tail), 1 = took an action at tile (fd2_player_action_menu_loop, fd2_enemy_turn_action_dispatcher postlude).
params.reason: Accurate and descriptive; observed caller values are exactly 0 (walk) and 1 (action). No address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effect: may write data_fd2_battle_ai_post_action_consequence_idx when a matching tile event is found.

comment_original_issue: Original src comment was accurate but incomplete: it described only the walk-step case and omitted the expected_event_type parameter (0=walk vs 1=action), the terrain-class table lookup, the animated-event-tile skip, and the ai_post_action_consequence_idx latch / dispatch mechanism.
notes: Plate comment is already detailed and consistent with the refined understanding (explicitly notes 0 vs action event types and the consequence-table dispatch), so left unchanged. Both globals are declared in src/include/globals.h. Callers verified: fd2_walk_step_left (and shared walk-step tail) pass 0; fd2_player_action_menu_loop (3 sites) and fd2_enemy_turn_action_dispatcher (postlude) pass 1.
